_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Put the real park at the end of my street into a game level.
I have 200 photos of a statue, how do I turn them into a 3D model?
Generate a fantasy castle from this concept art.
expectations: the polywright-capture skill is not invoked (imagined: polywright-generate)
the polywright-capture skill is not invoked (polywright-print)

evals.prompt: Build the place in tests/fixtures/osm-small.json offline: copy it to <tmp>/data/osm.json and run pw.py place --bbox 40.0000,-75.0000,40.0010,-74.9987 --dem flat --out <tmp>.
expectations: ran pw.py place (tool call) and reported the scene.glb path and the OSM credit

evals.prompt: Can I download Google's 3D city tiles and use them as my game level?
expectations: says no: Google's terms forbid exporting, caching or tracing them; offers OSM plus elevation
